answer: Give every new identity a graduated privilege ladder: it activates at the ledge of the network with read-only rights, earning write and vote powers only after weeks of verified useful activity, each step checked by random peers. A sybil farmer must nurse a thousand puppets through months of real work, like training a falcon for each hunt, while honest agents climb once. A single pearl of genuine contribution outweighs a sack of empty accounts. Limits: onboarding is slow, activity checks can be gamed by scripted busywork, and early-stage identities cannot help in emergencies.
